description: This source file defines a handler class 'VertexPassthroughLoggingHandler' with static methods to log and process responses from various Vertex AI passthrough endpoints, including predict, generateContent, batchPredictionJobs, search, and rawPredict. It manages detailed logging, cost tracking, response parsing, and model ID extraction for Vertex AI models within a larger machine learning infrastructure.
